name: PortraitCallouts
job: Show one person (owner, chef, founder) with fine lines drawn from the portrait to short facts around it, such as years in trade, favourite tool and signature piece (twist: a personal introduction in one glance, like an annotated figure)
visitor_action: hover or tap a callout to enlarge it; others quiet down
mobile: portrait on top with numbered anchors on the photo; name, role and facts stack below as a numbered list; tapping a fact spotlights its anchor
motion: Staggered entrance: key light blooms, portrait wipes up while the camera pushes in and pulls focus (blur to sharp), name words rise from masks, anchors pop with a ripple, leader lines draw out to their elbows and terminal dots, then facts rise. Hovering, focusing or tapping a fact spotlights its area of the photo (the rest dims to cobalt, a lens ring glides between spots, the photo pushes in toward it). Reduced-motion: everything shown at once; spotlight changes by opacity only, no push-in
provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Cobalt studio: saturated cobalt backdrop with a soft key light and floor falloff, a large portrait with cast shadow, crop marks and cobalt light spill, an oversized tight sans name overlapping the photo, crisp white hairline leader lines with square elbow joints and acid-lime terminal dots, readable label/value facts (14px label, 19px value)
notes: 2026-11-23: redesigned (batch A) to Cobalt studio. Weakness: anchor spots sit at fixed horizontal positions on the photo (20%/80%), so the spotlight can land on background rather than a meaningful detail on some crops; lines only show at 760px+ container width.
